validation_checks.name: Task threading — SOP to Production
validation_checks.details: All 69 task IDs in sop_modules.json have matching rate entries in production.json. Zero SOP-only or production-only tasks. 64 TSK_XWRP_* + 5 TSK_RRP_EXT_* tasks in both files.

validation_checks.name: UOM consistency — SOP to Production
validation_checks.details: Unit of measure matches for all 69 tasks across sop_modules.json and production.json. UOM values used: EA (55 tasks), FIXED (9 tasks), SF (2 tasks). No LF tasks. No mismatches.

validation_checks.name: Task count — SOP to Production
validation_checks.details: SOP total = 69, Production total = 69. Both files report identical by_module and by_classification breakdowns: 59 binary + 10 qt_scaled + 0 qt_conditional = 69. Module counts match: SETUP=12, ASSESSMENT=7, PREP=12, PRIME=4, INTERSTAGE=4, FINISH=10, CLEANUP=15, RRP=5.

validation_checks.name: Material system coverage — SOP references vs materials.json
validation_checks.details: SOP modules reference primer selection by substrate_state and cladding via applies_when fields. materials.json defines 7 material systems: SYS_PRIMER_EXT_ACRYLIC_STAINBLOCK, SYS_PRIMER_EXT_CHALK_BINDING, SYS_PRIMER_ALUMINUM_DTM, SYS_PRIMER_EXT_PVC_BONDING, SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC, SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE, SYS_FF_PREMIUM. All primer systems map to substrate_state and cladding_type conditions documented in MOD_XWRP_PRIME. All finish systems map to quality_tier. No orphaned or missing systems.

validation_checks.name: Coverage profiles — resolution.json proposed vs materials.json defined
validation_checks.details: Resolution proposed 5 coverage profiles: COV_XWRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC, COV_XWRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND, COV_XWRP_PRIMER_DTM_SPOT, COV_XWRP_PRIMER_PVC_SPOT, COV_XWRP_FINISH. Materials.json defines all 5 under profile_id. All profile IDs match.

validation_checks.name: Consumable completeness
validation_checks.details: Materials.json defines 19 consumables: CON_ASSESSMENT_KIT, CON_BRUSH_ANGLED_SASH, CON_MASKING_TAPE_BLUE, CON_MASKING_PAPER, CON_MASKING_FILM, CON_SANDPAPER_150, CON_SANDPAPER_180, CON_SANDPAPER_220, CON_SANDPAPER_320, CON_TACK_CLOTH, CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID, CON_CAULK_ACRYLIC, CON_GLAZING_COMPOUND, CON_GLASS_SCRAPER, CON_SCRAPER_CARBIDE, CON_DROP_CLOTH_CANVAS, CON_POLY_SHEETING_6MIL, CON_BIOCIDE_SOLUTION, CON_WOOD_HARDENER. All consumables referenced in SOP task descriptions have entries. All use CON_ prefix (no CONS_ violations).

validation_checks.name: Enum compliance
validation_checks.details: All enum values verified against resolution.json applicable_enums: phase values (setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup) — compliant, no 'protect' or 'protection' phase used. task_classification values (binary/qt_scaled) — compliant, no 'qt_conditional' used (correct per spec). skill_level values (helper/journeyman/lead) — compliant. sheen values (satin/semi-gloss/gloss) — compliant, no compound values. substrate_state values (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT/SS_EXT_CHALKING/SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING) — compliant. severity values (critical/major/minor) — compliant. consumable_category values — compliant.

validation_checks.name: Prohibited values / keys
validation_checks.details: No prohibited keys found: no 'task_class' (only 'task_classification'), no 'rate_per_hour' in sop_modules.json, no 'CONS_' prefix, no 'coverage_sf_per_gallon' in SOP. production.json uses 'rate_per_hour' for 2 SF-based tasks (TSK_XWRP_LANDSCAPE_PROTECT, TSK_XWRP_HARDSCAPE_PROTECT) which is valid in production.json per structural_reminders.

validation_checks.name: Module phase ordering
validation_checks.details: Module phase sequence: MOD_XWRP_SETUP=setup, MOD_XWRP_ASSESSMENT=prep, MOD_XWRP_PREP=prep, MOD_XWRP_PRIME=prime, MOD_XWRP_INTERSTAGE=interstage, MOD_XWRP_FINISH=finish, MOD_XWRP_CLEANUP=cleanup, MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT=prep. Phase ordering is correct: setup -> prep (assessment + prep + RRP) -> prime -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup. RRP containment is correctly mapped to prep phase.

validation_checks.name: Modifier stacking partition — prep vs coating pool
validation_checks.details: Prep pool modifiers (FAC_CONDITION_SCALE, FAC_XWRP_RRP) are never applied to coating tasks. Coating pool (quality_tier) is never applied to prep tasks. Verified in production.json: all prep-pool tasks have modifier_pool='prep' and include FAC_CONDITION_SCALE and/or FAC_XWRP_RRP. All coating-pool tasks have modifier_pool='coating' and do not include condition or RRP modifiers. Fixed tasks have modifier_pool='none'. No cross-contamination detected.

validation_checks.name: Round configurations alignment
validation_checks.details: Resolution proposed 4 rounds: ROUND_XWRP_2FINISH, ROUND_XWRP_PRIME_2FINISH, ROUND_XWRP_2PRIME_2FINISH, ROUND_XWRP_PRIME_2PRIME_2FINISH. Production.json defines all 4 with matching IDs, applies_when conditions, total_coats (2/3/4/4), and interstage_cycles (1/2/3/3). Module sequences are coherent and match the round descriptions.

validation_checks.name: Registry additions flagged
validation_checks.details: Resolution.json registry_additions_proposed lists 16 entries: 1 SF_ (SF_WINDOW_EXT_RP), 1 TSK_ prefix (TSK_XWRP_*), 1 MOD_ prefix (MOD_XWRP_*), 4 ROUND_ IDs, 5 COV_ profiles, 1 FAC_ modifier (FAC_XWRP_RRP), 2 CON_ consumables (CON_SCRAPER_CARBIDE, CON_POLY_SHEETING_6MIL). All new IDs used in downstream artifacts match proposed registry additions. No unregistered new IDs detected.

validation_checks.name: Classification consistency — SOP to Production
validation_checks.details: Task classification matches for all 69 tasks between sop_modules.json and production.json. No mismatches. 59 binary + 10 qt_scaled.

observations.description: Production.json uses rate_per_hour for 2 SF-based protection tasks (TSK_XWRP_LANDSCAPE_PROTECT at 200 SF/hr and TSK_XWRP_HARDSCAPE_PROTECT at 250 SF/hr). All other tasks use fixed_time_minutes or size_bucket_rates or qt_rates. rate_per_hour is valid in production.json per structural_reminders but is the minority pattern in this spec. Consistency is maintained since these are the only SF-UOM tasks and rate_per_hour is the natural expression for area-based rates.
observations.recommended_action: No action needed. Pattern is correct for SF-based tasks.

observations.description: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is a shared module not owned by this spec. Its 5 tasks use TSK_RRP_EXT_* prefix (not TSK_XWRP_*). This is correct per cross-spec sharing convention — shared modules retain their own prefix. The SOP correctly documents this as a shared module.
observations.recommended_action: No action needed. Shared module convention is followed correctly.

observations.description: Resolution proposed ROUND_XWRP_PRIME_2PRIME_2FINISH naming is slightly ambiguous (prime + 2prime + 2finish could be misread). Production.json clarifies: this is 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats for QT5 FAIR/POOR. The total_coats=4 and interstage_cycles=3 are consistent with the description. ROUND_XWRP_2PRIME_2FINISH (QT5 GOOD) has identical coat structure but different applies_when conditions.
observations.recommended_action: No action needed. Round names are documented clearly in both files.

observations.description: Task count of 69 exceeds the research projection of ~63 tasks. Reconciliation note in sop_modules.json explains: research projected 61 XWRP-prefixed tasks; actual is 64 XWRP-prefixed + 5 shared TSK_RRP_EXT_* = 69. The +3 delta is explained by the shared RRP module absorbing 2 projected RP_NEW tasks and adding 5 tasks total, yielding net +3. This is well-documented and reasonable.
observations.recommended_action: No action needed. Delta is explained and documented.
